concerns.text: No task creates a checksum for the generated Möbius array (`data/raw/mobius_array.npy`). According to Constitution Principle III, datasets must be checksummed before they are consumed by downstream tasks (e.g., T004, T007). Add a checksum‑generation task (e.g., T000 [ ] [US1] Compute and record SHA‑256 of `mobius_array.npy`).

SC‑003 requires the full pipeline to finish within ≤ 6 hours, but there is no task that measures or asserts total execution time. Add a monitoring task (e.g., T019 [ ] [US1] Measure total runtime of `python -m code.main` and fail if > 6 h).
SC‑004 requires peak memory usage < 7 GB, yet no task records memory consumption. Add a profiling task (e.g., T020 [ ] [US1] Track peak RAM during pipeline execution and abort if > 7 GB).
